name: Monika Hohlmeier - Proposition de décision
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2023, Section I – European Parliament
part_text:
The European Parliament has signed off on how it spent its own budget in 2023. This is called granting discharge. It means Parliament formally accepts that its money was used for the right purposes and that its spending followed the rules. The European Court of Auditors found no serious weaknesses in the spending it checked. Parliament's President and its top official had already confirmed the accounts were in order. The report does not change any rules or spending; it closes the book on the 2023 budget.

- Parliament formally approves its own 2023 spending and closes the accounts.
- It affects Parliament's own administration and the officials who manage its budget.
- The decision goes to the Council, the Commission and the Court of Auditors, then is published.
